gateAdditions.reason: A new step. No existing step, assertion, deadline or budget changed; the browser step globs tests/e2e/*.test.mjs and does not descend, so the new directory needs a step of its own.

supersessionScope: Extension only. Adds the fifteen managed-plugin-activation rows of ADR-050 decision 10. Every revision-3 row, productionIdentity, existingGateChangeScope and fixtureClockRevision is carried over verbatim; nothing is relaxed. Approval of ADR-050 authorises no key creation, key enrolment, signing, publication or activation on any machine.
coverageMeaning: state keeps its revision-3 meaning: NOT_RUN means the row has not been checked against a real production release. coverage records only whether a test in this repository exercises the row, using synthetic evidence (a throwaway signing key and a temporary HOME); synthetic evidence never authorizes release, so a COVERED row is still NOT_RUN. coveredBy cites each test by a string found in the named file, and tests/lib/distribution-trust-v4.test.mjs checks that it exists and is not skipped. uncovered states in words every clause of the row that no test exercises.

isolatedHomeE2E.method: Spawns the compiled CLI's real `init` with HOME in a temporary directory. The shipped build pins no release key, so each scenario runs a throwaway copy of the compiled CLI, under os.tmpdir(), whose pin constant is rewritten to the fingerprint of an ephemeral Ed25519 key that signed a fixture plugin set. The shipped build is shown to refuse the same set. Nothing outside the temporary directory is read or written, and the evidence grants no release authority.
isolatedHomeE2E.crashBoundariesNote: The transaction journals eight phases; every one is crashed. The ARCH names six durable boundaries, which these include.
